records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Revenue: For fiscal 2025, revenue was $37.9 billion, an increase of nine percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for fiscal 2025 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades and additional subscriptions from existing customers.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation, which represents all future revenue under contract yet to be recognized, as of January 31, 2025 was approximately $63.4 billion, an increase of 11 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: For fiscal 2025, the increase in cost of revenues in absolute dollars was primarily due to an increase in employee-related costs, including stock-based compensation expense, partially offset by a decrease in amortization of purchased intangibles and a decrease in service delivery expenses.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Income from Operations: For fiscal 2025, income from operations was $7.2 billion as compared to $5.0 billion from a year ago.
